sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 237 x 223 x 365 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Genelec 8040B product page (downloaded and read): "1 x XLR Analog Input", "Analog signal input connector XLR female, balanced 10 kOhm", mains "100, 120, 220 or 230VAC 50/60Hz according to region" (the inlet type is not named: iec-c14 follows the Genelec 8030C precedent), "Height 350 mm" without Iso-Pod and "365 mm" with it, "Width 237 mm", "Depth 223 mm", bass cone 165 mm, 19 mm metal dome tweeter. Documents the connector set (portsDocumented): one XLR analog input and the mains inlet. The plan size 237 x 223 x 365 mm includes the 15 mm Iso-Pod, modelled as a 15 mm foot pad under the body.

build params: the shipped Genelec 8030C recipe scaled to 237 x 223 x 365 (rounded polygon plan, elliptic fillets, a shallow barrel arc), a 15 mm foot pad for the Iso-Pod, a 168 mm woofer recess at 135 mm and a 40 mm tweeter recess at 290 mm in a 92 mm waveguide dish. Recess positions and the barrel are estimates from the datasheet outline, not measured. Port and control positions on the rear: no drawing or photo was opened, so every position is a plausible guess (confidence guess).

build.projection io + opposite: our own generic artwork (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): the rear panel with sockets drawn at the port positions and the baffle with drivers drawn at the datasheet sizes; no photo copy, no brand mark, no lettering. Colour: a studio-monitor default, lifted for the creation lighting.
